FAQ

Parents ke common sawaal

What is the admission process?＋

Fill the enquiry form or WhatsApp us. Our office calls you within 24 hours, schedules a campus visit, and completes simple documentation. No donation, no entrance test for early classes.

What classes does the school offer?＋

Play Group to Class 10. Each class has limited seats to keep class sizes small and attention personal.

What are the fees?＋

Affordable, transparent fee structure with easy monthly options. Fee details are shared during the campus visit — no hidden charges, ever.

Is transport available?＋

Yes, GPS-tracked school transport covers major areas of [City], with a trained attendant on every route.

How do parents get updates?＋

Through WhatsApp — homework, notices, results and attendance. Regular parent-teacher meetings every term.

What are the school timings?＋

Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM. Admission office: 9 AM – 2 PM on working days.
